brief: Separate legitimate tax planning from hiding or falsifying facts in a financial record.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Truthful Reporting"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Usa reglas sin alterar hechos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Use regras sem mudar fatos"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Separate legitimate tax planning from hiding or falsifying facts in a financial record.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Choosing a permitted treatment is different from inventing the facts needed to qualify.
instruction.misconception: Reducing tax justifies hiding income or fabricating an expense when a lawful benefit is unavailable.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: A permitted deduction uses true qualifying expenses. Inventing a receipt changes the facts rather than choosing a lawful treatment.
The claim follows the rule using genuine evidence.
The changed amount no longer represents the real transaction.
Correcting the duplicate restores the true expense total.
Comparing lawful treatments does not require falsifying facts.
Cash receipt remains a fact to assess under applicable rules.
A proposed false date changes evidence rather than applying rules.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
